description: What the web Agent API answers for one request over a given shop state (packages/contracts/openapi/web-agent-api.yaml, 'Checks run in this order'). Asserted by apps/web-ecommerce (AgentLimits.ts, Jest) and by apps/agent-service (domain/growth/policies.py `evaluate`, which FakeShop uses). Each vector's `state` replaces the keys of `base` it names; `settings` holds agent settings by key, merged over the defaults of ../agent-settings.json one level deep (a partial `autonomy` keeps the other capabilities' defaults). `grant`: a verified approval grant covers the request. `expect`: the status, and for a refusal the error `code` and, when given, its `reason`. Amounts are whole VND; times are UTC (Vietnam is UTC+7).
